title: Solidcore STEP reader: four mesh laws of the removed truck modules have no pin on the new path

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Found while working #917 part 1 (PR B, branch `issue/917-solidcore-step`). The branch removes 11 truck `step_*` modules of `crates/app/src/geometry/import/` with 100 `#[test]` markers. `docs/decisions/917-solidcore-step.md` ("Removed truck modules") maps each law to a pin on the solidcore path. Four laws guard against a wrong mesh and have no pin on the new path:

1. **Unmeasured face.** `Unmeasured::NoSurface` (`crates/kernel/src/mesh_deviation.rs`, mapped to `MeshRefusal::Unmeasured` in `machining_mesh.rs`) is never forced by a test. Old pins: `step_fit_tests.rs` (`a_face_without_surface_parameters_is_logged_and_reported_unmeasured` and its twin).
2. **Boundary point on its own sheet.** No test puts a boundary point of a many-turn flank, a root band or a fold through the reader and asserts its sheet or a refusal. Only `twisted_flank.step` (volume) and `twisted_flank_off.step` (refusal) pin the class. Old pins: `step_nearest_tests.rs` (8).
3. **Orientation in every order.** No test asserts that the outward result is the same when the facets or faces come in another order. Old pins: `step_orient_tests.rs` (`conflicting_votes_give_one_answer_on_every_run_and_in_every_order`, `the_first_gap_named_is_the_same_in_every_order`).
4. **Seam bow against the gap tolerance.** No STEP-level test asserts that a seam bowed within the tolerance closes and a seam past it is refused. Old pins: `step_seams_tests.rs` (`a_boundary_bowed_within_the_gap_tolerance_is_closed`, `the_importer_closes_seams_within_two_chord_tolerances_only`).

No wrong output is known. The solidcore internals are in the external `solidcore` git dependency, so each pin is a fixture or a record edit at the kernel seam (`crates/kernel/tests/`).

Done means: each of the four laws has a pin in `crates/kernel/tests/` (or `crates/geometry/tests/`), or the decision file records why the law has no object for solidcore, with the reading that proves it.
